moments.title: Equinox Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The grassroots music and arts Equinox Festival begins today in Lincolnshire, running until Monday.

angles.name: Morning Buzz
angles.copy: Kicking off today! Equinox Festival brings live bands, DJs, workshops, and family vibes to Lincolnshire until Monday. Who's heading there?

angles.name: Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Your weekend just got an upgrade! Equinox Festival is live from today in Lincolnshire. Get ready for some serious grassroots music and art.

moments.title: All Things Fungi Festival Opens
moments.blurb: The UK's first dedicated mushroom festival, All Things Fungi, opens tomorrow in the South East, featuring workshops, lectures, and culinary experiences focused on fungi education and sustainability.

angles.name: Unique Festival
angles.copy: Something a bit different! The UK's first ever All Things Fungi Festival starts tomorrow. Get ready for workshops, talks, and mushroom-inspired food in the South East.

angles.name: Sustainable Living
angles.copy: Fancy learning about sustainability with a twist? The All Things Fungi Festival kicks off tomorrow with workshops and culinary experiences all about mushrooms.

moments.title: York Food & Drink Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The York Food & Drink Festival, celebrating the best local and regional produce, begins tomorrow and runs until September 27th.

angles.name: Foodie Alert
angles.copy: Calling all foodies! The York Food & Drink Festival starts tomorrow, showcasing the best of Yorkshire's produce until September 27th. Who's going to indulge?

angles.name: Taste of Yorkshire
angles.copy: Tomorrow marks the start of the York Food & Drink Festival! Head to Parliament Street and St Sampson's Square for a feast of local flavours and demonstrations.

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival Starts
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex kicks off its Pumpkin Festival on Saturday, featuring over a million pumpkins, seasonal food, and entertainment until October 31st.

angles.name: Autumn Fun
angles.copy: Get ready for pumpkin spice and everything nice! Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival starts this Saturday in West Sussex with over a million pumpkins to pick!

angles.name: Family Day Out
angles.copy: Looking for a fun family day out this weekend? Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival opens Saturday in West Sussex, bringing seasonal food and entertainment.

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival Returns
moments.blurb: The renowned Abergavenny Food Festival takes place this weekend, September 19-20, in Monmouthshire, South Wales, offering tastings, chef demos, and a Party in the Castle.

angles.name: Welsh Foodie Weekend
angles.copy: Abergavenny Food Festival is THIS WEEKEND! Two days of tastings, chef demos, and a Party in the Castle in Monmouthshire. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Party in the Castle
angles.copy: Beyond the food, Abergavenny Food Festival also features a Party in the Castle with two stages and fireworks! Don't miss it this Saturday and Sunday.

moments.title: Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival
moments.blurb: The Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival runs this weekend, September 19-20, at Downhills Park, London, celebrating the harvest season with food, crafts, and live entertainment.

angles.name: London Harvest
angles.copy: North London! The Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival is on this weekend at Downhills Park. Celebrate the season with delicious food and unique crafts.

angles.name: Weekend in Tottenham
angles.copy: Live entertainment, artisan crafts, and tasty food – the Tottenham Harvest Food & Makers Festival is happening this Saturday & Sunday. Get down to Downhills Park!

moments.title: How The Light Gets In Festival
moments.blurb: The philosophy and music festival, How The Light Gets In, takes place this weekend, September 19-20, at Kenwood House, Hampstead Heath, London.

angles.name: Mind & Music
angles.copy: Deep thoughts and good tunes this weekend! How The Light Gets In Festival is on at Kenwood House, Hampstead Heath – a unique blend of philosophy and music.

angles.name: London Weekend
angles.copy: Looking for something inspiring? How The Light Gets In Festival brings leading thinkers and award-winning artists to Hampstead Heath this Saturday and Sunday.

moments.title: Heritage Open Days Conclude
moments.blurb: The annual Heritage Open Days, offering free access to thousands of historic sites across England, conclude this Sunday, September 20th.

angles.name: Last Chance
angles.copy: Final call for Heritage Open Days! Thousands of historic sites across England close their doors to free visitors this Sunday. Don't miss out on exploring hidden gems!

angles.name: Explore England
angles.copy: Still time to discover England's history for free! Heritage Open Days finish this weekend. Check local listings for places near you.

moments.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
moments.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on Monday, September 21st.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Birthday
angles.copy: Monday marks 54 years of rock 'n' roll swagger for Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the legendary frontman?

angles.name: Iconic Voice
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to Liam Gallagher on Monday! Still one of the most distinctive voices in British music. Play us your top Liam track!

moments.title: Live Music Week at Regent's Park
moments.blurb: Regent's Park Open Air Theatre in London hosts a Live Music Week starting Tuesday, September 22nd, featuring acts like Echo and The Bunnymen and Doves.

angles.name: London Gigs
angles.copy: Live Music Week kicks off at Regent's Park Open Air Theatre on Tuesday! Catch Echo and The Bunnymen, Doves, and more under the stars.

angles.name: Open Air Vibes
angles.copy: Experience some iconic bands in an iconic setting! Regent's Park Live Music Week starts Tuesday. Who are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Wigtown Book Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Scotland's National Book Town hosts the Wigtown Book Festival from September 25th to October 4th, with over 200 literary events.

angles.name: Scottish Literary Scene
angles.copy: Bookworms, unite! The Wigtown Book Festival, Scotland's National Book Town, starts next Friday with over 200 events. Who's planning a trip North?

angles.name: Culture in Scotland
angles.copy: From September 25th, immerse yourself in literature at the Wigtown Book Festival. It's a fantastic celebration of books and ideas.

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026-27 Gallagher Premiership Rugby season begins next Friday, September 25th, with Round 1 fixtures including Exeter Chiefs v Gloucester on Saturday 26th.

angles.name: Rugby Season Starts
angles.copy: The Gallagher Premiership Rugby season is back next Friday! Round 1 includes Exeter Chiefs taking on Gloucester this Saturday the 26th. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Chiefs Are Back
angles.copy: Devon rugby fans, get ready! Exeter Chiefs kick off their Premiership campaign this Saturday the 26th against Gloucester. It's going to be a massive start to the season!

moments.title: England Face Spain at Wembley
moments.blurb: England's men's senior football team kicks off their UEFA Nations League campaign against new world champions Spain at Wembley Stadium on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Football Fever
angles.copy: Big game next Saturday! England take on new world champions Spain at Wembley in their Nations League opener. Get ready for some top-tier football!

angles.name: Wembley Clash
angles.copy: It's England vs. Spain at Wembley next Saturday, September 26th! The Three Lions begin their UEFA Nations League journey against formidable opponents.

moments.title: Sense and Sensibility Film Release
moments.blurb: A new film adaptation of Sense and Sensibility, filmed in Dartmoor and Devon, is released on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Devon on Screen
angles.copy: Exciting news for Devon! A new Sense and Sensibility film, shot right here in Dartmoor and Devon, is out next Saturday. Who's seeing it?

angles.name: Classic Adaptation
angles.copy: Jane Austen fans, rejoice! A new Sense and Sensibility film hits cinemas next Saturday, September 26th. Perfect for an autumnal watch!

moments.title: Great British Harvest Festival
moments.blurb: The Great British Harvest Festival, a fundraising event celebrating farming heritage and music, takes place at St Edmundsbury Cathedral in Bury St Edmunds on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Suffolk Celebration
angles.copy: Bury St Edmunds! The Great British Harvest Festival is on next Saturday at the Cathedral, celebrating farming, rural communities, and amazing musical talent.

angles.name: Harvest Music
angles.copy: An evening of entertainment and British food: The Great British Harvest Festival takes place next Saturday, featuring the National Youth Choir and Orchestra of the Royal College of Music.

moments.title: Autumn Show & Horse Trials
moments.blurb: The Autumn Show & Horse Trials combine for a fantastic autumnal outing at the South of England Showground in Ardingly, West Sussex, on September 26th and 27th.

angles.name: Countryside Weekend
angles.copy: Celebrating rural life and equestrian pursuits! The Autumn Show & Horse Trials are on next weekend in West Sussex. Who's heading to Ardingly?

angles.name: Horse Trials
angles.copy: Top riders will compete in showjumping, dressage, and cross-country at the Autumn Show & Horse Trials next Saturday and Sunday. Plus, try fly casting and axe throwing!

moments.title: Avril Lavigne Turns 42
moments.blurb: Canadian pop-punk icon Avril Lavigne celebrates her 42nd birthday on Sunday, September 27th.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Princess
angles.copy: Can you believe it? Avril Lavigne turns 42 on Sunday! From 'Complicated' to 'Sk8er Boi,' what's your favourite track from the pop-punk princess?

angles.name: Still Rocking
angles.copy: Happy 42nd birthday to Avril Lavigne this Sunday! Still rocking stages and topping charts. Let's celebrate her incredible career!

moments.title: Blackpool Illuminations Ongoing
moments.blurb: The iconic Blackpool Illuminations continue to light up Lancashire every night until January 2027, a major attraction since 1879.

angles.name: Northern Lights
angles.copy: Don't forget the Blackpool Illuminations are still shining bright every night until January! A perfect autumn evening out.

angles.name: UK Attraction
angles.copy: Planning a trip up north? The historic Blackpool Illuminations are ongoing, offering a spectacular light show for all ages.
